list_models.description: List Strata's installed model run configs (ids are Strata's model tags, such as qwen3.8-flash-next-q2_0). Needs no running engine.

loaded_models.description: List the model this Strata instance is serving (it serves exactly one). The name it reports is what peers and the proxy route inference requests by.

pull_model.description: Download a model and its engine components without serving (params: {"model": "<family/quant>"}). Strata names a model as a family and quant pair, so qwen/q2_0 fetches with --family qwen --model q2_0; an id without a slash uses the qwen family. Needs no running engine.

load_model.description: Serve a different model (params: {"model": "<family/quant>"}). Strata serves one model per instance, so this saves the family and quant into the launch arguments and restarts the engine on them; if the new model does not start, the previous selection is restored.

unload_model.description: Stop serving the loaded model (params: {"model": "<served name>"}). Strata serves one model per instance, so this stops its serving process and frees the GPU while keeping the saved launch selection; Load or Start serves that model again.
